primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact ABIL B 8843 INCI PEG-14 Dimethicone. Producer identifies use as plasticizing agent for hair-setting polymers and fixatives; not a silicone gum claim.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Korea Cosmetic Association ingredient dictionary
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact entry gives hair conditioning and other skin conditioning purposes; own association dictionary, no film mechanics or grade evidence.

primary_supplement_sources.author: BASF
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Dehyquart CC 7 BZ INCI Polyquaternium-7; described as conditioning polymer for hair-conditioning formulations. No automatic film, adhesion or persistence class is assigned.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Clariant
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact PEG-60 Hydrogenated Castor Oil chemical name, nonionic solubilizer with solubilizing/emulsifying effect. No pure castor-oil identity or persistence prior transferred.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Health Canada NHPID
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact Hydroxyethyl Urea entry lists humectant and skin-conditioning humectant. No hair film inferred.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Dow
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact Dipropylene Glycol personal-care grade supports water/oil/hydrocarbon cosolvent function. No grade, concentration or sensory transfer to finished product.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Health Canada NHPID
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Glycine constituent entry includes exact glycine chemical substance and topical buffering/skin-conditioning purposes. No gum, repair, hair conditioning or persistence role assigned.

primary_supplement_sources.author: BASF
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Cetiol Ultimate exact INCI Undecane (and) Tridecane provides a reviewed volatile pair and hair/skin leave-on vehicle function. Presence does not identify supplier blend or percentage in candidate.

primary_supplement_sources.author: BASF
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Cetiol OE exact Dicaprylyl Ether INCI supports emollient function only; skin-feel claims not transferred to hair persistence.

primary_supplement_sources.author: AB Specialty Silicones / Andisil
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Primary personal-care supplier table identifies exact Disiloxane and Trisiloxane under volatile linear siloxanes. Grade is not identified in finished product.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Seppic
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Primary supplier indexed page names exact combination; C13-14 Isoalkane now named formerly Isoparaffin. Describes thickening/stabilizing/texturizing, not evidence of a conditioning film or supplier-grade identity in Metal Detox.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Dow
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Primary supplier describes ultra-high-viscosity dimethiconol gum in different carriers for leave-on conditioning hair oils. Ingredient function clue; no exact commercial grade, dose or finished coating performance established.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Health Canada NHPID
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact Sodium Benzoate ingredient entry includes topical antimicrobial preservative purpose. No concentration or safety ruling transferred.

primary_supplement_sources.author: European Commission SCCS
primary_supplement_sources.summary: SCCS fragrance-substance table names exact INCI Anise alcohol among individually labelled fragrance allergens. Identity/function only; no quantitative threshold or product exposure inferred.

primary_supplement_sources.author: Korea Cosmetic Association ingredient dictionary
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Exact Caramel ingredient entry gives colourant and fragrance purposes; no coating or persistence role inferred.

primary_supplement_sources.author: European Commission Joint Research Centre
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Table 52, printed page 141, lists exact CI 15985 and CI 19140 as ingredients with colourant function. No toning performance or hair coating inference.

primary_supplement_sources.author: European Commission / EU Cosmetics Regulation Annex IV identity table
primary_supplement_sources.summary: Annex IV entry 55 identifies beta carotene as Colour Index 40800, orange. Used solely for exact CI40800/Beta-Carotene label identity and colourant function, no current compliance or concentration determination.
